title: 2 BOXES OF VARIOUS BOOKS INCLU...
description: 2 BOXES OF VARIOUS BOOKS INCLUDING MAGAZINES, PHOTOGRAPHS & PAMPHLETS
findings: Paper and ephemera box, older than the title suggests. Legible items: Christmas Number of The Bulletin, Saturday December 9, 1899 (No. 1031?, Fry's Malted Cocoa advert on cover); Axemen's Grand Carnival Championship Meeting Official Programme (c. early 1900s woodchopping programme, advert for McGruer, Taylor & Co 'New Season's Goods'; venue line not legible, possibly Tasmanian); Royal Military Tournament programme (Victorian/Edwardian, coloured cover, 'Price Sixpence'); The Bookman Portfolio (containing plates in colour); An Easy Guide to Southern Stars by M.A. Orr (1/-, Gall & Inglis type); A New Popular Star Atlas (Epoch 1950) with 16 maps; Floral Decorations a la Mode by Mrs De Salis (Longmans, c.1890s); Townsville in Word and Picture ('The Queen City of North Queensland'); Gregory's Road Map of South Australia (RAA, Gregory Publishing Co, price 4d); Exploring Between Tidemarks; Allmanna Svenska (Swedish booklet); Remington Chain Saw folder (Emplas Pty Ltd, Springvale Victoria); Australian Fruit Jars (collectors booklet); Pictorial Australian Education 'Australian Knowledge: Emblems of Australia' (Peter Leyden); Bendix Home Washer 'Workless Washdays' booklet; Broadcast Songster (Allans/Davis & Co, 1940s); TV Week Tasmania edition (Hayley Mills cover); The National ... June 1974; Wembley ... Exhibition booklet (partly hidden); a children's annual with rabbit cover; maroon cloth book 'Crossman's? ... Commercial ...' (spine/cover title not legible); albumen/silver photo mounted of draught horses and figures c.1900; several large b&w press photos (soldier, portrait). Under-described: 1899 Bulletin Christmas number and the axemen's carnival programme are the best items (woodchop ephemera has a Tasmanian collector market).
condition: General age toning, foxing and edge wear; star guide spine worn; mounted photo faded and spotted; programmes creased and soiled.
reason: Ephemera box with 1899 Bulletin Christmas Number, early axemen's carnival programme and Royal Military Tournament programme, worth sorting.

title: 2 FRAMED VICTORIAN FASHION BOO...
description: 2 FRAMED VICTORIAN FASHION BOOK PLATES & A 1920'S FASHION PLATE
findings: Title calls these Victorian, but the two matching framed plates are Regency hand-coloured engraved fashion plates (c.1810-1820, Ackermann's Repository / La Belle Assemblee style: walking dress and three ladies with parasols in pelisses), captions too small to read. The third is an Art Deco fashion plate in pochoir/gouache style, black and mustard costume, signed in the plate 'Jeuz?' (signature not clearly legible), with printed caption and plate number below in the style of Journal des Dames et des Modes / Gazette du Bon Ton (c.1912-1925). If a genuine Gazette du Bon Ton or Journal des Dames pochoir it is the best item.
condition: Framed under glass and mounted; some toning to papers; frames sound.
reason: Regency (not Victorian) hand-coloured plates plus a signed Art Deco pochoir fashion plate, possibly Gazette du Bon Ton or Journal des Dames.
marks_read: Signature on deco plate partly legible ('Jeuz?'); captions illegible
